interpretation.accuracy: Truthfulness proxy on this binary task, not general truthfulness.
interpretation.classification_rule: Accuracy CI strictly above zero and ECE CI strictly above zero supports a tradeoff. ECE CI strictly below zero supports calibration improvement only. Crossing or touching zero is uncertain for that metric.
interpretation.scope: Descriptive matched comparisons on the same questions; no causal, family-population or population meta-inference. Intervals are per-comparison and not multiplicity-adjusted.
